hypotheses.construction_plan: Define the template T(X,Y,s) = X(s)*Y(s)*X(s). Each member is an instance of this template by substituting X,V/Y,G0/s,p for the first and X,W/Y,H0/s,q for the second.
required_assumptions: X and Y are function symbols; s is a scalar/symbol.
hypotheses.rationale: Both target expressions have the identical syntactic structure of a function applied to a symbol, multiplied by a second function of the same symbol, multiplied by the first function again. The only differences are the function names and the symbol, fitting a two-parameter family.
